newsitem.title: ALBANIA: Europe and CIS port conditions - Lloyds.
newsitem.headline: Europe and CIS port conditions - Lloyds.

text.p: Port conditions from Lloyds Shipping Intelligence Service --

ALBANIA, March 3 - Durres - Three vessels discharging of which 2 bagged cement, 1 bagged wheat flour. Vessels in roads awaiting berth for discharging, 1 bagged rice, 1 general cargo, 1 bagged wheat flour, 1 kerosene.

BULGARIA, March 2 - Bourgas - 10 Vessels operating of which 5 loading, 1 zinc, 1 timber, 2 steel, 1 chemicals, 1 vessel discharging coal. 3 Discharging/loading of which 1 containers/general, 1 sugar/metals, 1 containers/metals, 1 empty vessel. 12 Vessels waiting in roads of which 5 to load, 1 benzene, 1 steel, 1 fertiliser, 1 chemicals, 1 coils/lead. 2 To discharge sugar and zinc concentrates, 1 to discharge/load cards, 3 empty vesels, 1 awaiting orders. 19 Vessels due of which 11 load, 4 fertiliser, 1 timber, 3 steel, 1 chemicals, 1 bentonite, 1 metals. 2 To discharge, 1 wheat, 1 lead concentrates, 5 to discharge/load containers, 1 empty vessel.

Varna - 28 Vessels operating of which 22 loading, 1 cigarettes, 1 scrap, 3 fertiliser, 2 quartz sand, 4 soda, 1 tsp/bags, 1 clinker, 1 glass products, 1 soda/ntp, 1 ntp, 1 sas, 1 general, 1 edc, 1 cement, 1 tsp, 1 frozen chicken. 2 Discharging, 1 cotton, 1 copper concentrates, 1 discharging/loading trucks/containers, 3 discharging/loading containers. 6 Vessels waiting in roads of which 2 to load cement and urea, 4 cargoes not nominated.

CROATIA, March 3 - Rijeka - Two vessels discharging at berth, 1 loading at berth, 3 at inoperative berth, 5 under repair/drydock, 8 due, 2 anchored, delays expected. Zadar - Two vessels under repair/drydock, 2 due, delays expected. Split - Three vessels discharging at berth, 1 under repair/drydock. Ploce - One vessel discharging at berth, 1 loading at berth. Pula, Rasa, Sibenik, Dubrovnik - No vessels.

CYPRUS, March 4 - Limassol - Vessels due 5/3, 11 containers, 1 conventional vessel, 3 passenger vessels, no delays expected. 5 Container vessels discharging/loading at berth, 2 conventional vessels discharging at berth. Larnaca - Vessels due 5/3, 1 container vessel, 3 conventional vessels, no delays expected. 1 Container vessel discharging/loading at berth, 2 conventional vessels discharging at berth.

ESTONIA, March 4 - Tallinn - City port - 6 Vessels due, no delays expected. 2 Vessels loading at berth, 1 discharging at berth. Kopli - 8 Vessels due, 3 loading at berth (2 sawn timber, 1 phosphate). Parnu - 3 Vessels loading timber at berth. Parnu will be closed from 4/3 until the end of March due to ice. Muuga - 5 Vessels loading at berth (3 fuel oil, 1 peat, 1 timber). 4 Vessels discharging at berth (1 benzene, 2 fish, 1 poultry. 1 Fertiliser vessel waiting at anchorage to discharge.

ITALY, March 4 - Naples - One gas tanker to berth 4/3. Gaeta - One bulk carrier to berth 4/3. Salerno - No vessels in roads. Genoa commercial port - Three vessels in roads, no delays, 30 vessels berthed, 4 in drydock. Multedo oil harbour - No vessels, no delays. Savona - No vessels in roads, no delays, 3 vessels berthed. Do Ligure - One vessel in roads, 2 vessels berthed, no delays. La Spezia - No vessels in roads, no delays, 17 vessels berthed, 5 under repair/drydock. Leghorn - Four vessels in roads, no delays, 40 vessels berthed. Civitavecchia, Gaeta, Naples, Salerno, Palermo, Ancona, Falconara - No vessels in roads, no delays.

Augusta oil harbour - Five vessels in roads, some delays, 2 vessels berthed. Syracuse oil harbour - Six vessels in roads, some delays, 4 berthed. Sarroch - Three vessels in roads, 4 vessels berthed. Taranto - Three vessels in roads. Ravenna - Three vessels in roads. Venice - One vessel in roads. Trieste - One vessel in roads.

LATVIA, March 4 - Ventspils - Seven vessels in port of which 6 operating, 2 steel loaders, 2 mop loaders, 2 beer dischargers, 1 vessel awaiting operations, no delays. 13 Vessels due. Riga - 19 Vessels in port of which 14 operating, 4 timber loaders, 2 container loaders, 2 metal loaders, 2 tanker loaders, 1 cotton loader, 2 fish dischargers, 1 wheat discharger. 5 Vessels awaiting operations, no delays, 15 vessels due. Liepaja - Seven vessels in port of which 3 operating, 4 awaiting operations, no delays, 2 vessels due.

LITHUANIA, March 3 - Klaipeda - Vessels loading, 1 pellets, 7 fertiliser, 1 metal, 1 container vessel, 1 pig iron, 1 steel coils, 1 steel sheets. Discharging, 3 fish, 3 fish powder, 1 corn, 1 soy pellets, 1 grain. 2 Vessels loading/discharging, 6 in roads, 37 due.

POLAND, March 4 - Gdynia - 16 Vessels operating. 6 Vessels loading at berth (4 general cargo, 2 bulk). 10 Vessels discharging at berth (5 general cargo, 2 bulk, 1 coal, 2 grain. 5 Vessels under repair/drydock, 30 due. Gdansk - Nine vessels operating, 1 coal vessel awaiting turn. 6 Vessels loading at berth (1 bulk, 3 general cargo, 2 coal). 3 Vessels discharging at berth 2 bulk, 1 general cargo). 3 Vessels under repair/drydock, 14 due. Szczecin - 101 Vessels due, 62 loading at berth, 36 discharging at berth, 2 waiting at anchorage to load, 2 waiting at anchorage to discharge, 14 under repair/drydock.

PORTUGAL, March 3 - Leixoes - Vessels operating, 7 general cargo, 4 containers vessels. Places vacant, 9 piers with cranes, 1 pier without cranes. Sines - Vessels operating, 1 each discharging coal/ice, 1 each loading unleaded gasoline, propylene, gasoil/jet fuel. 2 Vessels waiting of which 1 to discharge chemical naphtha, 1 to load cargo. Vessels due, 2 to discharge crude, 1 each to load fuel oil, ethylene, butadiene. March 4 - Setubal - Three vessels loading at berth, 2 discharging at berth. 5 Vessels under repair/drydock. Vessels due, 7 for discharging, 2 for loading, 1 for repair/drydock. Lisbon - 37 Vessels due, 70 in port of which 20 unloading at berth, 5 loading and unloading at berth, 18 under repair/drydock, 7 awaiting orders, 20 miscellaneous craft.

ROMANIA, March 3 - Constanta - 34 Vessels operating of which 14 generals, 4 bulkers, 8 bagged chemicals, 4 tankers, 2 bagged cement, 2 containers. 6 Vessels waiting in roads of which 5 generals, 1 tanker. Constanta Sud (Agigea) - No vessels loading/discharging. Midia - Four vessels loading livestock.

RUSSIA, March 3 - BALTIC PORTS - St. Petersburg - 18 Vessels operating of which loading, 2 non-ferrous, 3 fertiliser, 2 containers, 2 cellulose, 1 coal. Discharging, 2 frozen meat, 2 containers, 2 frozen chicken, 1 rice, 1 bananas. 8 Vessels awaiting operations, 14 due. Kaliningrad - Five vessels operating of which 1 urea loader, 1 ferrous loader, 1 alumina loader, 1 fish discharger, 1 fruit discharger. No delays, no vessels due. Vyborg - One vessel operating, no delays.

BLACK SEA, March 4 - Novorossiysk - 18 Vessels operating of which 14 loading, 2 scrap, 1 rice, 7 steel, 1 aluminium, 1 copper, 1 coal, 1 fertiliser. Discharging, 2 various, 1 cars, 1 rice. 16 Vessels waiting in roads of which 6 to load, 2 scrap, 2 steel, 1 slabs, 1 copper cathodes. 9 To discharge, 3 sugar, 2 rice, 1 maize, 1 pipes/containers, 1 building materials, 1 copper cathodes, 1 to discharge/load containers. 44 Vessels due of which 3 to to load, 1 cement, 2 scrap, 10 steel, 1 copper, 4 copper cathodes, 1 aluminium, 1 lead, 1 nitrate phosphates, 1 cellulose, 1 urea, 2 coal, 1 seeds, 3 paper, 1 barytes. 14 To discharge, 3 sugar, rice, 4 citrus, 1 equipment, 2 luggage, 1 cars. Oil terminal - 2 Tankers berthed loading crude oil, 3 tankers waiting in roads (crude oil, fuel oil, 1 awaiting customs decision). 5 Tankers due to load, 3 crude oil, 2 diesel oil. Pipeline closed 3/3 at 1015 hours for 3 days for repairs.

NORTHERN BASIN - Murmansk - Eight vessels operating of which 3 alumina, 1 npk, 1 apatite, 1 steel, 1 cabotage, 1 aluminium. 4 Vessels waiting of which 1 alumina discharger, 3 loaders (1 coal, 2 apatite). 15 Vessels due of which 10 loaders (3 apatite, 1 coal, 1 aluminium, 1 non-ferrous metals, 1 iron ore pellets, 3 steel). 5 Dischargers (3 alumina, 2 cabotage).

SLOVENIA, March 3 - Koper - Seven vessels berthed of which 1 container loading/discharging, 1 bulk carrier loading coal, 1 discharging magnesite, 1 general cargo loading rails, 1 ferry loading/discharging, 1 livestock loading bulls, 1 tanker discharging gasoline. 11 Vessels due of which 3 containers, 3 car carriers to load and discharge, 2 general cargo to load sawn timber, general cargo, 1 bulk carrier to load grain, 1 tanker to discharge gasoline, 1 tanker to discharge oil, no delays expected.

SPAIN, March 4 - Aviles - Seven vessels in port of which 3 loading steel products, 4 discharging (2 zinc concentrates, 1 dunite, 1 sap). Gijon - Ten vessels in port of which 6 loading (2 cement, 2 steel products, 1 pieces, 1 sugar). 4 Discharging (1 iron ore, 1 butane gas, 2 petroleum products). 3 Vessels anchored outside. Sagunto - 18 Vessels operating of which 3 ro/ro discharging/loading general cargo, 8 discharging steel products, 2 loading/discharging general cargo, 1 discharging fresh fruit pallets, 2 loading fertiliser, 2 discharging logs,timber. No vessels outside commercial wharf, no berthing delays.

TURKEY, March 3 - Istanbul - Haydarpasa - 9 Vessels operating of which 4 containers, 4 dry cargo, 1 ro-ro, no berthing delays. Galata - 7 Cargo/passenger vessels operating, port congested. Ambarli - 12 Vessels operating, no berthing delays. March 4 - Mersin - Nine Vessels awaiting orders. 19 Vessels operating of which loading, 2 cement, 1 glass, 1 citrus, 1 legumes, 1 soda. Discharging, 1 potato seed, 1 wheat, 1 legumes, 1 container vessel, 1 rail, 1 soy bean, 2 raw oil, 1 cargo. Loading/discharging, 1 container/cargo, 3 container vessels. Free zone piers - 1 Vessel loading cotton, 1 discharging sugar. Seka - One vessel loading fertiliser.

UKRAINE, March 3 - Mariupol - Eight vessels loading at berth (fertiliser, sunseed, sulphur, coal, containers, urea). 2 Vessels discharging at berth (alumina, general cargo). 1 Vessel under repair, 4 waiting at anchorage to load (metal products, sulphur, containers). 12 Floating storehouses (sulphur, fertiliser). 24 Vessels due (metal products, fertiliser, chrome ore, coal, oranges, sulphur, general cargo, containers). Kerch - Five vessels under repair, 1 due to discharge manganese ore. Berdiansk - Two vessels loading at berth, 1 waiting at anchorage to load coke, 1 due to load fertiliser.

Mariupol - Eight vessels operating of which 5 loading, 4 fertiliser, 1 sunseeds. 1 To discharge alumina, 1 to discharge/load equipment, containers/alumina, containers, 1 to discharge/load containers. 4 Waiting in roads for loading, 1 scrap, 2 sulphur, 1 containers. 24 Vessels due, 14 to load, 3 fertiliser, 3 slabs, 3 coal, 1 ferrous metals, 4 steel. 3 To discharge, 1 chrome ore, 1 citrus, 1 equipment. 2 To discharge/load, 1 equipment/slabs, 1 containers/ferrous metals. 5 To discharge/load containers. Odessa - 17 Vessels operating of which 8 loading, 1 fertiliser, 2 paper, 3 metal, 1 sunseed, 1 oil. 2 Discharging detergent, citrus. 2 Under repair, 2 waiting, 3 passenger vessels. 9 Waiting in roads of which 7 to load, 4 sunseed, 2 metal, 1 fertiliser, 2 cargo not nominated. 7 Due of which 5 to load, 4 metal, 1 sunseed. 2 To discharge/load containers.

YUGOSLAVIA, March 4 - Bar - Eight vessels berthed of which 3 discharging bananas, 1 discharging caustic soda, 1 discharging gasoline, 1 loading alumina and zinc, 1 loading metal, 1 loading steel coils. No delays. Zelenika, Bijela - One vessel discharging jet fuel, 2 vessels laid up, 2 under repair.
